admission.justification: Spans tags_engine call-site capture and grammars test-case refusal, range, and TypeScript anchor spelling resolution, guarded by case-definition, case-range, and writer case-proof suites.

applicability: JavaScript, TypeScript, and TSX test/spec files and TypeScript anchor spelling resolution.
conditions: tags_engine.extract_test_calls captures @test.* call sites declaratively via tests.scm in pre-order document order.
grammars.test_case_refusal and grammars.test_case_range feed those call sites from the call-scoped parse cache into test_cases.refusal and test_case_ranges.case_at.
grammars.typescript_anchor_identifier remains a spelling resolver keyed by active TypeScript provider version under request_memo_scope.
exclusions: Non-test/spec filenames and non-JS/TS languages do not run tests.scm or acquire test-case definitions.

evidence: 307 dashboard test/spec files differential (0 diffs), mcp/tests/test_memory_case_ranges.py, mcp/tests/test_memory_citation_grammars.py, mcp/tests/test_writer_case_proofs.py; clean-copy tree e122f928d620ee2485100752a3d16ed709100bac

statement: JavaScript and TypeScript test-case definitions, blocking refusals, and line-range proofs flow from declarative tests.scm call-site captures into the existing policy layer while typescript_anchor_identifier remains a spelling resolver.
title: Declarative tests.scm calls feed JS/TS case policy and spelling resolver
